facts.statement: At a common differentiability point, (u±v)'=u'±v' and (cu)'=cu' for constant real c. Exact signed increment identities precede taking limits.
conditions: Both functions take the same input increment h

facts.statement: Δ(uv)=vΔu+uΔv+ΔuΔv exactly; this includes signed increments.
conditions: Area picture uses positive u,v,du,dv only; algebra covers other signs

facts.statement: ΔuΔv/h=(Δu/h)Δv -> u' * 0 = 0 because differentiability implies continuity.
conditions: Merely shrinking area is not enough: normalized area must tend to zero
Two-sided differentiability is assumed, even though positive h is drawn

facts.statement: Δ(u/v)=[vΔu-uΔv]/[v(v+Δv)]. Original quotient requires v!=0 and v+Δv!=0.
conditions: The uv cancellation is explicit in the scene

facts.statement: (u/v)'=(u'v-uv')/v² provided both functions are differentiable and v!=0.
conditions: Continuity of v keeps denominator nonzero in a sufficiently small neighborhood

facts.statement: For real x>0 in a continuous approximation, C=x²+4 (hundred yuan), x in hundred items; A=C/x in yuan/item, A'=1-4/x² in (yuan/item)/(hundred items). Unique minimum A(2)=4 follows from A'<0 on (0,2), A'>0 on (2,infinity).
conditions: Not a claim about a measured factory or discrete demand
A'=0 alone is not the minimum argument

display_contract.formula_motion: Historical rows remain fixed; ordered du,dv transfer to a new row, no permutation transform
display_contract.dynamic_numbers: Approximation glyph; full model values drive all geometry
display_contract.timing: Visual fractions only; actual WAV will require local timing review
